'''Hammer of the Dark Side''' was a title that was taken by the former [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]] after he discovered the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of the late [[Warb Null]] and renamed himself "Malleus."
